title: Hydrogen storage performance of Ti0.75Zr0.25Mn0.9CrFe0.1 alloy with different preparation methods
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8623-8632
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08729E, Paper
Open Access

Yiqiang Mu, Yanchen Zhou, Guo Yang, Linhua Xu, Huimin Xu, Lixiao Zhu, Xingbo Han, Xinxin Chu, Wei Liu, Lijun Lv
Effects of preparation methods on hydrogen storage properties of Ti0.75Zr0.25Mn0.9CrFe0.1 alloy were studied. Melt-spinning improves microstructure uniformity, flattens the hydrogen absorption plateau, and enhances pulverization resistance.
